items.title: GE Vernova to Support India’s Energy Transition With 6-GW HVDC Transmission Project
items.summary: GE Vernova announced on Nov. 6 that it has been officially chosen by PowerGrid Corporation of India Limited (PGCIL) to deliver a critical 6-GW High-Voltage Direct-Current (HVDC) transmission corridor. The project was booked in the fourth quarter of 2026. This project will serve as a vital energy highway, enabling the efficient transport of 6 GW […]

items.title: Shortage of Turbines Drives Market for Second-Hand Market for AI Data Centers
items.summary: New gas turbines now take years to arrive, so AI data center developers are hunting for used machines and buying entire power plants. Five stocks sit on opposite sides of that scramble, and one of them is selling at a premium.

items.title: GE Vernova (GEV) Secures New Wind Turbine Order In Germany
items.summary: GE Vernova (NYSE:GEV) agreed a new onshore wind turbine supply deal in Germany with Stadtwerke Heidenheim. The contract expands GE Vernova’s installed base in the country and adds fresh volume to its German onshore wind backlog. Turbines for the project are set to be produced at GE Vernova’s Salzbergen facility, supporting localized manufacturing and logistics in Germany. The new Stadtwerke Heidenheim turbine order in Germany aligns with wider themes our research has uncovered around GE...

items.title: AMD Soars 12% on “Undeniable” Data Center Success per Oppenheimer Upgrade
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAMD shares jumped 12% today after Oppenheimer upgraded the stock to Outperform with a $600 target. Broadcom and GE Vernova also rose in a broad AI infrastructure rebound.

items.title: Trump Urges Senate to Make Data Centers “Pay for Their Own Electricity.” Power Builders Stand to Gain
items.summary: Key TakeawaysPresident Trump urged senators on Sunday to pass S. 5653, a permitting bill he says would speed up power plant construction and make data centers pay for their own electricity.

items.title: GE Vernova Soars 7% as Constellation Raises Guidance, Easing Data-Center Moratorium Fears
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGE Vernova shares jumped 7% today, with Bloom Energy and Vertiv, after Constellation Energy beat estimates and raised its 2026 guidance. Constellation’s new deals show data-center buyers are still signing, so last week’s moratorium selloff looks overdone.

items.title: Buy The Market’s Knee-Jerk Derisking of GE Vernova While You Can
items.summary: One election headline erased a fifth of GE Vernova's value in a month, yet the company just posted record orders. Sellers fixated on data centers, but the order book hints they may have misread who is actually buying.

items.title: Is the Options Market Predicting a Spike in GE Vernova Stock?
items.summary: Investors need to pay close attention to GEV stock based on the movements in the options market lately.
